_about: North Idaho companies, focused on Sandpoint, Ponderay, Sagle and Bonners Ferry, plus Priest River, Moscow and Lewiston, researched from public sources 2026-10-03. Found through the Greater Sandpoint Chamber member directory, Bonner County Daily Bee, Sandpoint Reader, Spokane Journal of Business and the companies' own sites. Every row carries the URLs it was taken from. Nothing is inferred: a field that could not be sourced is null. founded and headcount come only from the company's own site, its chamber listing, or local press, never an aggregator. Only positive or neutral sources are used. Coordinates come from the Mapbox Geocoding API applied to the sourced street address, and are null where no street address could be sourced. district is the nearest of sandpoint, bonners-ferry, moscow and lewiston (Ponderay, Sagle and Priest River map to sandpoint).

companies.name: Gierd
companies.what: Software that helps brands scale sales on online marketplaces such as Amazon, eBay and Walmart, with tools for pricing, demand forecasting, fraud protection and sales reconciliation. Headquartered in the Old Power House building near Sandpoint's docks.

companies.name: Daher Aircraft (Kodiak)
companies.what: Designs and builds the Kodiak, a 10-seat short takeoff and landing utility aircraft, in Sandpoint.

companies.name: Litehouse Foods
companies.what: Employee-owned maker of salad dressings, sauces, condiments, cheese and dips, with brands including Litehouse, Organicville, Veggiecraft and Sky Valley. Sandpoint-based, with a plant in Sandpoint.

companies.name: Encoder Products Company
companies.what: Designs and manufactures incremental and absolute rotary encoders for motion control, from its Sagle headquarters.

companies.name: Diedrich Roasters
companies.what: Builds handcrafted coffee roasting machines, from boutique specialty roasters to large commercial systems, plus roasters for cacao, with consulting, training and support.

companies.name: Timberline Helicopters
companies.what: Heavy-lift helicopter services, aerial firefighting and external-load work with a fleet of Black Hawk and K-MAX helicopters, plus a repair station. Building a $13 million, 50,000-square-foot facility near Sandpoint Airport.

companies.name: Granite Aviation
companies.what: Sandpoint Airport's fixed base operator, offering aircraft maintenance, flight training, aircraft rental and deicing.

companies.name: Sandpoint Computers
companies.what: Locally owned computer shop repairing Apple, Windows and Linux machines, with business network consulting, outsourced IT and network management.

companies.name: Like Media
companies.what: Print and digital marketing agency offering SEO, web development, social media and branding, and publisher of Living Local magazines for Sandpoint, Bonners Ferry, Coeur d'Alene and Gig Harbor.

companies.name: Survey Noodle
companies.what: AI-assisted survey platform that writes survey questions, follows up with respondents and summarizes the results. Started by Sandpoint entrepreneur Mike Peck.

companies.name: Matchwood Brewing Company
companies.what: Sandpoint's neighborhood brewery and eatery, making handcrafted beer.

companies.name: Pend d'Oreille Winery
companies.what: Makes award-winning wines, with a downtown Sandpoint tasting room and bistro.

companies.name: Sprig Herbals
companies.what: Produces whole-plant herbal extracts as flavor-forward formulas for food and drinks.

companies.name: Monarch Mountain Coffee
companies.what: Sandpoint coffee company selling its own blends, such as Cafe' Magnific and Espresso Trifecta, online.

companies.name: Sno Trac
companies.what: Small-batch manufacturer that re-engineered the 1950s Swedish Snow Trac into a modern, American-made tracked snow vehicle, designed, fabricated and assembled in Bonners Ferry.

companies.name: Überleben
companies.what: Outdoor and bushcraft gear brand known for ferrocerium fire starters, sold online from its Bonners Ferry base.

companies.name: Aerocet
companies.what: Builds aircraft floats, including the 1500 Amphib, 2200 and 3400 Amphib models, in Priest River.

companies.name: Lightcast
companies.what: Labor market data and analytics for employers, education and the public sector.

companies.name: NRS
companies.what: Designs paddling and river gear in-house in Moscow, including rafts, frames, life jackets and dry bags, sold through its catalog, website and Moscow flagship store.

companies.name: BioTracking
companies.what: Developed and markets BioPRYN, an early blood-based pregnancy test for cattle and other ruminants, based on research at the University of Idaho.

companies.name: Alturas Analytics
companies.what: Contract research lab providing LC-MS/MS and GC-MS/MS bioanalytical services for drug discovery and development.

companies.name: Anatek Labs
companies.what: Accredited analytical lab testing drinking water and wastewater, including PFAS, with labs in Moscow and Spokane.

companies.name: Hillcrest Aircraft Company
companies.what: Aviation services at Lewiston's airport: fixed base operator, aircraft maintenance, avionics and flight training.
